scope: G16 read-only persisted-run verification; G17-G20 out of scope
changes: Every successful persisted main_model call must have a request manifest that reconstructs from saved input and current tool schema and matches the selected model route.
The saved response must identify a matching model, provider, and generation ID; successful calls in one task cannot reuse the same provider/generation pair.
The verifier reports each successful call's request hash and response identity alongside its database task binding.

negativeCases: Saved successful answer without wire manifest is rejected
Altered request hash or missing provider generation ID is rejected
Changed route model with a recalculated journal input hash is rejected
Reused provider generation ID within one task is rejected
A valid mode-model route and manifest remains accepted

limitations: This binds saved journal data; it does not independently confirm a provider response or billing record.
No frozen independent Gold or real dual-arm model tasks have been verified by this change.
Corpus authorization and exact citation coordinates remain unverified; G16 quality gate is not passed.
